The full paper-scale work-unit plan remains frozen and machine-readable, while this run is explicitly reduced validation only.
Every target writes structured data and a check file without promoting scientific coverage.
No paper PDF, source figure, digitized curve, author numerical array, or author code enters the numerical runner.
